children: Polaryx Therapeutics appointed Will Charlton, M.D., M.A.S. as Chief Medical Officer to lead clinical execution for PLX-200 and the SOTERIA Phase 2 trial.
Appointed Will Charlton as Chief Medical Officer, effective September 1, 2026, strengthening clinical leadership.
Charlton brings nearly two decades in rare disease and pediatric drug development, including prior CMO roles.
His experience includes leading a Phase 2 rare disease program at Tyra and redesigning registrational studies at Spruce.
Appointment timed ahead of planned SOTERIA Phase 2 initiation in Q4 2026 to support PLX-200 clinical advancement.
